services.title: Winch-out and recovery
services.body: If it has come off the road or dropped a wheel, we run the line out and bring it back up before anything is loaded.
services.evidence: Enclosed box trailer being drawn up onto the rollback deck by the winch, the ramps down on

services.title: Car and light truck transport
services.body: Cars, pickups and vans ride flat on the deck and are chained at the points the manufacturer put there for it.
services.evidence: Rollback and a service pickup parked together on the gravel, the company name and number l

services.title: Heavy and oversize loads
services.body: Anything that will sit on a deck can move on one, from plant and trailers to whole buildings.
services.evidence: The workshop building on the yard with the roller door down and the open side bay running

services.title: Night and out of hours calls
services.body: Breakdowns do not keep office hours, and a good part of this work happens in the dark.

reviews.author: Mandy “K”
reviews.text: I was reffered to S and S by a local dealership, my family and I were stuck in a very traumatic situation and I cannot express anymore about the amazing service Shawn and his wife provided! This was the most outstanding experience especially under the circumstances. We were stuck on the highway nowhere near our destination! This man and his wife went above and beyond without hesitation. My family and I are still expressing how grateful we are to have had the assistance that S and S provided for us! 100% I recommend this towing company. This is not just your typical towing company they are complete angels and love what they do for others! If your in need call or text Shawn he will to step right up and make sure you are safe.

reviews.author: Angelique Colon
reviews.text: Listen!! these guys are a God send!! My brother recommended them to me and I had my car towed all the way from Cary to have them work on it! They were transparent and honest about cost and turnaround time. Great communication and reasonable prices! Overall a great experience all around! Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Danielle Mckay
reviews.text: Absolutely great service very reliable and very reasonable prices and very helpful. He went over and beyond his way to make sure my car was towed and I got a tire instead of towing me all the way to Laurinburg 100% recommended.
